first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6%. Both memory_31 and memory_86 show that simplifying onboarding and reducing friction at signup durably improve activation and completion rates. These effects directly address both current decline metrics. Verifying these specific records will confirm whether the prior approaches (field reduction, shortened paths) remain applicable and whether any implementation details were missed. This is lower-risk than promotional_pricing (which memory_73 flagged as harming 30-day retention) or referral_incentives (better suited for growth after activation is healthy). Enterprise_sales_assist is orthogonal to the SMB activation problem. A standard experiment on onboarding simplification is calibrated to the capacity constraint and has proven mechanism from recent memory.
